hero_kpi_rationale: Brunswick generates $5.4 billion in revenue, reflecting its position as a global leader in marine leisure products and its diversification across marine engines, boats, and accessories.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total revenue from the sale of products and services by the company.
kpis.description: Consolidated revenue shows a slight increase, reflecting a combination of volume, pricing, and acquisition factors.
kpis.signal: Moderate revenue growth driven by product mix and pricing.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Gross margin decreased by 100 basis points, primarily due to material inflation including tariffs, partially offset by higher sales and favorable currency translation.
kpis.signal: Decline in gross margin impacted by material inflation and tariffs.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by revenue, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Operating margin is negative at -0.8%, primarily due to restructuring, exit, and asset impairment charges ($353.1M), including $322.5M of impairment in the Navico group.
kpis.signal: Negative operating margin in 2025, affected by significant restructuring and impairment charges.

kpis.name: R&D Expense
kpis.explanation: Costs incurred for research and development of new products and technologies.
kpis.description: R&D expenses remain stable at $168.7M, representing 3.1% of revenue, indicating continued prioritization of technological innovation and ACES applications.
kpis.signal: Stable R&D investments, underscoring commitment to technological innovation.

kpis.name: Adjusted Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating margin excluding special items and acquisition accounting amortization.
kpis.description: Excluding restructuring charges, impairments, and acquisition amortization, adjusted operating margin is 6.9%, compared to 9.5% in 2024, reflecting underlying operational pressures.
kpis.signal: Adjusted operating margin of 6.9%, excluding impairments and restructuring charges.

kpis.name: Freedom Boat Club Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Net cost of acquiring Freedom Boat Club franchises and territories in South Florida.
kpis.description: Acquisition completed on September 12, 2024, of Freedom Boat Club franchises and territories in South Florida for a net cash consideration of $31.3M, strengthening position in the boat club segment.
kpis.signal: Strategic investment in the boat club model to expand participation in marine leisure.

kpis.name: Gross Margin %
kpis.explanation: Gross margin expressed as a percentage of net sales.
kpis.description: Gross margin stands at 24.8% in 2025 versus 25.8% in 2024, impacted by material and tariff inflation (250 bps), partially offset by sales mix improvement (120 bps).
kpis.signal: Tariff-related inflation partially offset by pricing gains.

kpis.name: Net Sales Growth
kpis.explanation: Increase in net sales compared to prior year.
kpis.description: 2025 revenue increased 2.4% to $5.4 billion, driven by improved market conditions in H2 and strong performance in the engines and accessories segment.
kpis.signal: Moderate growth driven by improved market conditions in the second half and large order intake.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Unfavorable Global Economic Conditions
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned first in the document (Item 1A). The language used is strong ('significantly affect', 'materially impact', 'adverse effect'). It is repeated and detailed, indicating a major concern for the company, especially for its discretionary products.

risks.title: Changes in Trade Policy and Customs Tariffs
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed and mentioned as affecting 'all our businesses'. The intensity of the language ('material adverse effect', 'volatile trade policy environment') and reference to specific tariffs indicate a significant and ongoing concern.

risks.title: Increased Costs of Raw Materials and Components
risks.score_rationale: This risk is extensively described, highlighting dependence on third-party suppliers and volatility in raw material prices. The intensity of the language ('detrimentally affect', 'significant disruption') and mention of shortages indicate high and current severity.

risks.title: Interest Rate and Credit Condition Risks
risks.score_rationale: This risk is clearly identified as affecting customers' ability to finance purchases, particularly boats. The impact on sales is direct and the language ('adversely affect', 'decrease in sales') is clear.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Rate Volatility
risks.score_rationale: This risk is well explained with concrete examples (sales in USD, costs in EUR/CAD/AUD/BRL). Although hedging programs exist, the language ('adversely affect', 'pricing pressures') indicates a potentially significant impact on revenues and competitiveness. Approximately 26% of annual revenue is in foreign currencies.

ai_positioning.summary: Brunswick explicitly mentions artificial intelligence and autonomous technologies as key strategic elements. The company identifies ACES applications (Autonomy, Connectivity, Electrification, Shared-Access) as areas of technological leadership and innovation, reflecting a focus on emerging technologies in the marine leisure sector.
evidence: Leading the industry in innovative technologies, including artificial intelligence and Autonomy, Connectivity, Electrification, and Shared-Access (ACES) applications
Investing in innovative, global product leadership and leveraging our leading brands to meet consumer needs
Engaging consumers with the richest, most intuitive digital experiences
